_comment: Structures. nav_cost: metres of detour the swarm accepts before bashing through (x10 internally). build_time: worker-seconds to construct (more workers = faster). staff: workers needed for it to function. category: build bar tab.

structures.name: Wall
structures.role: Cheap barrier. The swarm paths around it, or bashes through.

structures.name: Blast Door
structures.role: Heavy armoured door. Maulers deal x4 damage to doors.

structures.name: Floodlight
structures.role: Lights the ground around it. Turrets cannot see unlit targets at night (M5).

structures.name: Harvester Bay
structures.role: Launches harvester drones that collect Biomass from corpses in range. Drones also clear corpse piles off your walls.

structures.name: Guard Post
structures.role: Raised firing platform. Up to 2 soldiers garrison it and shoot with +4 m range.

structures.name: Mining Rig
structures.role: Build on a glowing Xenite deposit. A worker mines Xenite; the company buys it after every wave.

structures.name: Bio-Refinery
structures.role: +25% Biomass from every drone delivery (needs 1 worker; max 2 count).

structures.name: Fabricator
structures.role: -15% build and upgrade costs (needs 1 worker; max 2 count).

structures.name: Armory
structures.role: Unlocks tier III turret upgrades and +25% soldier damage (needs 1 worker).

structures.name: Medbay
structures.role: Wounded colonists recover twice as fast; soldiers on base heal (needs 1 worker).
